differences.justification: SystemDataV3 was removed from ModelVersion because the current service contract no longer exposes system data on model versions.
SystemDataV3 was removed because the current service contract no longer exposes this model.
Breaking change in beta operation: RoutineRun status changed from String to BinaryData to align with the current Routines preview contract.
Breaking change in beta operation: AttackStrategy enum values were removed to align with the current RedTeams preview contract.
Breaking change in beta operation: evaluator initialization parameter accessors were renamed to initializationParameters to align with the current Evaluations preview contract.
Breaking change in beta operation: ContinuousEvaluationRuleAction no longer exposes evalId in the current Evaluations preview contract.
Breaking change in beta operation: createGenerationJob was replaced by the long-running-operation beginCreateGenerationJob to align with the current Datasets preview contract.
Breaking change in beta operation: createEvaluatorGenerationJob was replaced by the long-running-operation beginCreateEvaluatorGenerationJob to align with the current Evaluators preview contract.

Breaking change in beta operation: BetaRoutines(Async)Client listRoutines/listRoutineRuns dropped the 'before' parameter and now take PageOrder instead of String for 'order' to align with the current Routines preview contract.
Breaking change in beta operation: DataGenerationJobType.TASK_GENERATION was renamed to SIMULATION_SEED to align with the current DataGenerationJobs preview contract.
Breaking change in beta operation: TaskGenerationDataGenerationJobOptions was renamed to SimulationSeedDataGenerationJobOptions to align with the current DataGenerationJobs preview contract.
Breaking change in beta operation: BetaRoutines(Async)Client createOrUpdateRoutine takes an additional optional 'authorization' parameter to align with the current Routines preview contract.
